title: Was Cleopatra Closer to the Pyramids or the MOON Landing? 🚀
description:
You'd think Cleopatra lived closer to the pyramids than to the Moon landing. Nope. The Great Pyramid of Giza was finished around 2560 BC, so when Cleopatra was born (69 BC) it was already about 2,500 years old: ancient history, even to her. From Cleopatra to Apollo 11 (1969) is only about 2,000 years, so she lived roughly 500 years closer to Neil Armstrong than to the pyramid's builders. Weirder still: while that pyramid was going up, woolly mammoths were still alive, on Wrangel Island in the Arctic, where the last of them lived until about 4,000 years ago. Pyramids or Moon: what did you guess?
